acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right new construction condo involves evaluating your lifestyle needs, budget, and desired location within Miami-Dade County, Broward County, or Palm Beach County. Consider factors like proximity to work, schools, amenities, and future development plans in the area. A key decision factor is to align your priorities with the developer's vision and the project's offerings, such as amenities like pools, fitness centers, or pet-friendly policies. Kelby Contreras specializes in these areas and can provide insights into specific developments that match your criteria.
